name: Université de Montréal
header:
Université de Montréal
Canada · Mathematics MSc (pure mathematics) / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 79. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• French-language eligibility is a material check even with a UChicago English-medium degree.
• International MSc deposit normally due April 1, earlier than many US funding-acceptance dates.
• No guaranteed MSc funding amount published.
• Do not treat international tuition-reduction award as spendable stipend.
• DirectPhD eligibility for an external bachelor remains ambiguous.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
MSc: math major/equivalent bachelor, minimum equivalent of 3.0/4.3. UChicago bachelor is an appropriate
degree type; individual equivalence/grades/language still evaluated. Direct PhD is exceptional and requires
supervisor support, identified project and ≥3.6 cumulative GPA under accelerated procedure; PhD regulations
specifically name exceptional UdeM bachelor holders, so UChicago direct-entry eligibility needs written
confirmation. Normal PhD requires relevant MSc and ≥3.3/4.3. [c] [d] [e]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Contact relevant faculty and discuss research/funding. Complete university application and separate
departmental research-experience form; collect official-record scans, CV and two references. Direct PhD adds
department approval, supervisor support and project. [b] [e] [f]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Department recommends contacting faculty before applying, especially for MSc funding. Form asks 1-3 names,
contact status and whether any agreed to supervise. DirectPhD requires supervisor support. [b] [f] [e]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
University application plus separate department research form, then Centre étudiant
checklist/uploads/reference tasks after welcome email. Check individual task deadlines regularly; completed
tasks disappear as receipt confirmation. [b] [i]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
MSc February 1 2027 application date confirmed explicitly. Standing departmental schedule coversPhD; fees
displayed forWinter 2027 and scholarship amounts for 2026-27, not guaranteedFall 2027 rates. [a] [b] [j] [o]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc Fall 2027 explicitly open August 1 2026-February 1 2027. Department standing rule is February 1 for fall
MSc/PhD, June 1 for winter; winter department date overrides central general schedule. Exact closing
time/timezone not published. [a] [b]

Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No distinct 2027 departmental funding deadline found. Tuition-exemption consideration is automatic with
admission; supervisor MSc funding and external awards have separate processes. [m] [o]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Each invitation link lasts 10 working days; follow the individual Centre étudiant task deadline. No separate
universal 2027 math-reference date found. Submit early enough for both the task cutoff and admissions
evaluation. [g] [i]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Any French-proof deadline is assigned through program/portal; no math-specific English-test or score cutoff
established. Do not import another program’s May 15 French deadline. [g] [p] [c] [d]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Central default: upload within 10 business days after application, but each Centre étudiant task can differ and
controls. February 1 2027 is the MSc application date, not an assumed common document cutoff. [i] [a]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Offer-specific acceptance deadline. International MSc entrants must also deposit CAD 1000: standing fall
deadline April 1, or within 10 days if admission arrives after March 20. Deposit credited to tuition; not a
PhD-wide deposit rule. [k] [l]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
No TOEFL/IELTS requirement or threshold appears in mathematics admissions materials. PhD regulations
explicitly require sufficient French and describe English knowledge as desirable; teaching is French. Graduate
French proof can be required case-by-case. [c] [d] [g]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
No English-test waiver needed on the published math checklist because no English test is specified. UChicago
English-medium study does not establish a French exemption: obtain graduate-committee authorization if
needed. MSc language arrangements and any French test should be confirmed. [c] [d] [g] [p]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Official transcript scans and diploma/degree evidence; current partial results allowed pending final records.
Central outside-Canada rule also asks final secondary-school records and all subsequent study, including
incomplete/exchange/failed courses. Upload official scans rather than screenshots. Non-English/French records
require certified French translations. Birth certificate also requested. [b] [g] [h]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Research form asks theoretical preparation in intended fields, including courses, books and seminars. No
separate standardized course-list upload found. [f]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Explain relevant preparation in the form; no standalone catalog/syllabus requirement stated. [f] [b]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two, French or English, directly from referees. Department prefers free-format letters over ESP template.
Direct-PhD procedure requires one recommendation from proposed research supervisor. UdeM former-student
exception does not apply to John. [b] [c] [e]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Automatic tuition exemption has no extra application/reference. Direct-entry/accelerated route may have a
scholarship but its award-specific reference/essay requirements were not established. [o] [e]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering recommender contact details in Centre étudiant triggers emailed PDF/link/code. Centre étudiant
access follows the university application/welcome email; no pre-submission invitation route established. [g] [i]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Operationally after university application: references are managed as Centre étudiant tasks. Public instructions
do not say that typing details in the original unsubmitted application sends invitations. [g] [i]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Completed reference task disappears: French instructions allow 48 hours; English says within a few hours.
Check dashboard rather than assume an email notification. [g] [h]
Updating and reusing letters [Conflict]
Pending tasks allow recommender/contact replacement. French instructions permit re-requesting expired
10-working-day links; English says find another recommender. Revision after receipt and reuse across
programs/cycles not publicly settled. [g] [h]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required CV upload; no published length, font or content template. General upload PDF rules apply. [c] [i]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No standalone SOP listed. The required departmental research form supplies academic motivation/preparation
information. [b] [c] [f]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement listed. [c]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required web form (faithful prompt summary): name intended research fields; explain theoretical preparation
using books/courses/seminars; describe research placements, papers/thesis, topics and results; identify 1-3
potential supervisors and contact/acceptance status; report awarded external funding, amounts and intended
award applications. No public word/character limit or formatting rule. [f]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Not a standalone MSc requirement. Exceptional direct PhD requires an identified research project submitted
through departmental approval; no public length/font rule. [c] [e]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Form asks research/thesis experience and results; a thesis/paper upload or writing sample is not on the
ordinary checklist. [f] [c]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Describe papers in research-experience response and CV. No separate publications-list requirement or
instruction to upload/link papers found. [f] [c]

Course-list document [Standing rule]
Theoretical preparation is embedded in the research form; see course-list entry. [f]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
No separate essay for automatic international tuition exemption. Department competitive-award prompts
announced to enrolled students; 2027 entry-specific forms/deadlines not established. [o] [m]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Uploads: PDF only, each task a file; chronological/paginated order; front/back if printed; consistent orientation;
filename<64 characters, file<10 MB, no password. Research form itself is online. [i] [f]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc: no guaranteed annual amount posted; negotiate supervisor support. PhD: minimum CAD 18,000/year
under policy effectiveFall 2025, including awards/teaching. Tuition is separate. 2026-27 international tuition
reductions: research MSc CAD 15,916.05/three full-time terms; PhD CAD 24,067.80/three terms, reducing
supplemental tuition - not a cash stipend or verified 2027-28 rate. [m] [n] [o]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Doctoral minimum 4 years; fifth-year completion award can be sought. MSc amount/duration
supervisor-dependent. [m] [n]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students included subject to funding-policy eligibility. Tuition exemption renewed for admissions
throughWinter 2028; excludes French/Francophone-Belgian candidates covered by other arrangements and
applicants with another exemption or external sponsor. Valid CAQ/studypermit, continuous full-time
registration required. [n] [o]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD: full-time with supervisor; disclose all funding; apply for eligible external scholarships;
progress/course/exam/research milestones; accept teaching if French sufficient. Non-Francophones must take
a French course before end of sixth term. Milestone bonuses CAD 500, thesis completion bonus CAD 2000. [n]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Tuition exemption automatic, email after accepting offer. MSc supervisor funding requires discussion; PhD
policy requires external-scholarship applications and annual progress documentation after enrollment. [o] [m]
[n]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Supervisor grants; teaching; Serge-Bissonnette math award CAD 5000; Alexis-Gerbeau MSc award CAD 5000
after≥6 coursecredits; ESP/FAS scholarships and eligible FRQ/NSERC competitions. Department award
applications announced to enrolled institutional email; no universal pre-admission entitlement. [m]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
Latest displayed schedule is Winter 2027: CAD 83.40 base per term plus 23.35 per regular program =106.75
for one math application. Fall 2027 amount not independently confirmed. Pay on submission; accepted
Visa/VisaDebit/Mastercard/ApplePay/GooglePay; noAmEx. Same account/session avoids repeated base fee. [j]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No general international math application-fee waiver found. Tuition-exemption scholarship is unrelated to the
application fee. Contact admissions for exceptional payment difficulty; do not assume a waiver. [j] [o]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
1. Algebraic geometry / geometric representation theory
Jake Levinson
Moduli of stable curves, Schubert calculus, toric geometry, equivariant resolutions and algebraic
combinatorics. [q] [r]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Rational curves in projective toric varieties
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
2. Complex geometry
Maxime Fortier Bourque
Conformal/Riemann surfaces, Teichmüller geometry and extremal invariants on moduli spaces. [q] [w]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 · The dimension of Thurston’s spine
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
3. Number theory / arithmetic
Matilde Lalín
L-functions over function fields, Mahler measure, character families and arithmetic statistics. [q] [s]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Murmurations of quadratic and cubic characters over function fields
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Andrew Granville
Analytic number theory, multiplicative functions, character sums, primes, with arithmetic-geometry
connections. [q] [u] [v]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Mixed character sums modulo prime powers
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Dimitris Koukoulopoulos
Analytic/probabilistic number theory, multiplicative functions, sieves and Diophantine approximation. [q] [t]

Current professor; personal page explicitly invites strong MSc/PhD applicants to email and apply; specific 2027 capacity not
guaranteed.
Research evidence: 2026 · A logarithmic structure theorem for multiplicative functions with small partial sums
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
4. Representation theory / algebraic geometry
Leonid Rybnikov
Gaudin/Bethe algebras, Yangians, integrable systems and moduli/toric compactifications. [q] [x]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.

text:
Université de Montréal
Canada · Mathematics MSc (pure mathematics) / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 79. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• French-language eligibility is a material check even with a UChicago English-medium degree.
• International MSc deposit normally due April 1, earlier than many US funding-acceptance dates.
• No guaranteed MSc funding amount published.
• Do not treat international tuition-reduction award as spendable stipend.
• DirectPhD eligibility for an external bachelor remains ambiguous.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
MSc: math major/equivalent bachelor, minimum equivalent of 3.0/4.3. UChicago bachelor is an appropriate
degree type; individual equivalence/grades/language still evaluated. Direct PhD is exceptional and requires
supervisor support, identified project and ≥3.6 cumulative GPA under accelerated procedure; PhD regulations
specifically name exceptional UdeM bachelor holders, so UChicago direct-entry eligibility needs written
confirmation. Normal PhD requires relevant MSc and ≥3.3/4.3. [c] [d] [e]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Contact relevant faculty and discuss research/funding. Complete university application and separate
departmental research-experience form; collect official-record scans, CV and two references. Direct PhD adds
department approval, supervisor support and project. [b] [e] [f]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Department recommends contacting faculty before applying, especially for MSc funding. Form asks 1-3 names,
contact status and whether any agreed to supervise. DirectPhD requires supervisor support. [b] [f] [e]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
University application plus separate department research form, then Centre étudiant
checklist/uploads/reference tasks after welcome email. Check individual task deadlines regularly; completed
tasks disappear as receipt confirmation. [b] [i]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
MSc February 1 2027 application date confirmed explicitly. Standing departmental schedule coversPhD; fees
displayed forWinter 2027 and scholarship amounts for 2026-27, not guaranteedFall 2027 rates. [a] [b] [j] [o]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc Fall 2027 explicitly open August 1 2026-February 1 2027. Department standing rule is February 1 for fall
MSc/PhD, June 1 for winter; winter department date overrides central general schedule. Exact closing
time/timezone not published. [a] [b]

Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No distinct 2027 departmental funding deadline found. Tuition-exemption consideration is automatic with
admission; supervisor MSc funding and external awards have separate processes. [m] [o]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Each invitation link lasts 10 working days; follow the individual Centre étudiant task deadline. No separate
universal 2027 math-reference date found. Submit early enough for both the task cutoff and admissions
evaluation. [g] [i]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Any French-proof deadline is assigned through program/portal; no math-specific English-test or score cutoff
established. Do not import another program’s May 15 French deadline. [g] [p] [c] [d]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Central default: upload within 10 business days after application, but each Centre étudiant task can differ and
controls. February 1 2027 is the MSc application date, not an assumed common document cutoff. [i] [a]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Offer-specific acceptance deadline. International MSc entrants must also deposit CAD 1000: standing fall
deadline April 1, or within 10 days if admission arrives after March 20. Deposit credited to tuition; not a
PhD-wide deposit rule. [k] [l]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
No TOEFL/IELTS requirement or threshold appears in mathematics admissions materials. PhD regulations
explicitly require sufficient French and describe English knowledge as desirable; teaching is French. Graduate
French proof can be required case-by-case. [c] [d] [g]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
No English-test waiver needed on the published math checklist because no English test is specified. UChicago
English-medium study does not establish a French exemption: obtain graduate-committee authorization if
needed. MSc language arrangements and any French test should be confirmed. [c] [d] [g] [p]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Not listed among mathematics admission requirements; explicit optional/ignored/prohibited policy not found.
[b] [c] [d]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Not listed; no explicit mathematics GRE policy found. [b] [c] [d]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Official transcript scans and diploma/degree evidence; current partial results allowed pending final records.
Central outside-Canada rule also asks final secondary-school records and all subsequent study, including
incomplete/exchange/failed courses. Upload official scans rather than screenshots. Non-English/French records
require certified French translations. Birth certificate also requested. [b] [g] [h]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Research form asks theoretical preparation in intended fields, including courses, books and seminars. No
separate standardized course-list upload found. [f]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Explain relevant preparation in the form; no standalone catalog/syllabus requirement stated. [f] [b]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two, French or English, directly from referees. Department prefers free-format letters over ESP template.
Direct-PhD procedure requires one recommendation from proposed research supervisor. UdeM former-student
exception does not apply to John. [b] [c] [e]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Automatic tuition exemption has no extra application/reference. Direct-entry/accelerated route may have a
scholarship but its award-specific reference/essay requirements were not established. [o] [e]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering recommender contact details in Centre étudiant triggers emailed PDF/link/code. Centre étudiant
access follows the university application/welcome email; no pre-submission invitation route established. [g] [i]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Operationally after university application: references are managed as Centre étudiant tasks. Public instructions
do not say that typing details in the original unsubmitted application sends invitations. [g] [i]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Completed reference task disappears: French instructions allow 48 hours; English says within a few hours.
Check dashboard rather than assume an email notification. [g] [h]
Updating and reusing letters [Conflict]
Pending tasks allow recommender/contact replacement. French instructions permit re-requesting expired
10-working-day links; English says find another recommender. Revision after receipt and reuse across
programs/cycles not publicly settled. [g] [h]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required CV upload; no published length, font or content template. General upload PDF rules apply. [c] [i]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No standalone SOP listed. The required departmental research form supplies academic motivation/preparation
information. [b] [c] [f]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement listed. [c]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required web form (faithful prompt summary): name intended research fields; explain theoretical preparation
using books/courses/seminars; describe research placements, papers/thesis, topics and results; identify 1-3
potential supervisors and contact/acceptance status; report awarded external funding, amounts and intended
award applications. No public word/character limit or formatting rule. [f]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Not a standalone MSc requirement. Exceptional direct PhD requires an identified research project submitted
through departmental approval; no public length/font rule. [c] [e]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Form asks research/thesis experience and results; a thesis/paper upload or writing sample is not on the
ordinary checklist. [f] [c]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Describe papers in research-experience response and CV. No separate publications-list requirement or
instruction to upload/link papers found. [f] [c]

Course-list document [Standing rule]
Theoretical preparation is embedded in the research form; see course-list entry. [f]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
No separate essay for automatic international tuition exemption. Department competitive-award prompts
announced to enrolled students; 2027 entry-specific forms/deadlines not established. [o] [m]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Uploads: PDF only, each task a file; chronological/paginated order; front/back if printed; consistent orientation;
filename<64 characters, file<10 MB, no password. Research form itself is online. [i] [f]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc: no guaranteed annual amount posted; negotiate supervisor support. PhD: minimum CAD 18,000/year
under policy effectiveFall 2025, including awards/teaching. Tuition is separate. 2026-27 international tuition
reductions: research MSc CAD 15,916.05/three full-time terms; PhD CAD 24,067.80/three terms, reducing
supplemental tuition - not a cash stipend or verified 2027-28 rate. [m] [n] [o]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Doctoral minimum 4 years; fifth-year completion award can be sought. MSc amount/duration
supervisor-dependent. [m] [n]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students included subject to funding-policy eligibility. Tuition exemption renewed for admissions
throughWinter 2028; excludes French/Francophone-Belgian candidates covered by other arrangements and
applicants with another exemption or external sponsor. Valid CAQ/studypermit, continuous full-time
registration required. [n] [o]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD: full-time with supervisor; disclose all funding; apply for eligible external scholarships;
progress/course/exam/research milestones; accept teaching if French sufficient. Non-Francophones must take
a French course before end of sixth term. Milestone bonuses CAD 500, thesis completion bonus CAD 2000. [n]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Tuition exemption automatic, email after accepting offer. MSc supervisor funding requires discussion; PhD
policy requires external-scholarship applications and annual progress documentation after enrollment. [o] [m]
[n]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Supervisor grants; teaching; Serge-Bissonnette math award CAD 5000; Alexis-Gerbeau MSc award CAD 5000
after≥6 coursecredits; ESP/FAS scholarships and eligible FRQ/NSERC competitions. Department award
applications announced to enrolled institutional email; no universal pre-admission entitlement. [m]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
Latest displayed schedule is Winter 2027: CAD 83.40 base per term plus 23.35 per regular program =106.75
for one math application. Fall 2027 amount not independently confirmed. Pay on submission; accepted
Visa/VisaDebit/Mastercard/ApplePay/GooglePay; noAmEx. Same account/session avoids repeated base fee. [j]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No general international math application-fee waiver found. Tuition-exemption scholarship is unrelated to the
application fee. Contact admissions for exceptional payment difficulty; do not assume a waiver. [j] [o]

Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
General advice article says 30-day references and no supervisor referees, but operational instructions say 10
working days and directPhD explicitly needs supervisor letter. Use operational/degree-specific policy. PhD
regulations name exceptionalUdeM bachelors, whereas direct-entry page sounds broader; UChicago directPhD
requires confirmation. [z] [g] [e] [d]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm French requirement and possible exemption with ces-math@dms.umontreal.ca; external-bachelor
directPhD eligibility; Fall 2027 fee, individual supporting-document dates, scholarship rules, MSc funding and
supervisor availability. [b] [c] [d] [e] [m]
